library.name: MultiFTPServer
library.author: Renzo Mischianti <renzo.mischianti@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Multi FTP server for esp8266, esp32, STM32, Raspberry Pi Pico and Arduino
library.paragraph: Multi FTP server for Raspberry Pi Pico W (LittleFS), esp8266 (SPIFFS and LittleFS or SD, SdFat 2.x), esp32 (SPIFFS, LittleFS and FFAT or SD, SdFat 2.x) and Arduino (SdFat, SD basic lib with 8.3 file format), Wio Terminal (Seed_SD, SdFat 2.x), Arduino MKR (SdFat 2), STM32 (Flash >64K SdFat 2.x and SPI Flash). Support w5500, w5100 and enc28j60. With internal callback to check the phase of communication.

library.name: RumiCar
library.author: RumiCar-group <info@rumicar.com>
library.sentence: Library for controlling the RumiCar autonomous driving platform.
library.paragraph: Provides setup and control functions for steering and drive motors, and initializes three front VL53L0X laser distance sensors plus an optional rear VL53L0X (auto-detected). Supports Arduino AVR, ESP32, Spresense, and Raspberry Pi Pico W.
